display.purpose: Hero sections and major dashboard numbers.

body.purpose: Standard list rows and descriptive text.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #a34e32; color: #fffaf1; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); }

components.name: Card
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fffdf8; border: 1px solid #dce2d9; border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.25rem; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #18211d; } .ds-card h3 { font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 500; margin: 0 0 1rem 0; } .ds-card p { color: #657268; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: An inviting, organic interface defined by warm earthy tones and functional structure. The aesthetic relies on natural color pairings (terracotta and sage), soft ambient shadows, and legible sans-serif typography. Overall, the component execution feels somewhat uninspiring, serving as a functional wrapper rather than a distinct design statement.
keyCharacteristics: Layered and soft with large, diffuse drop shadows.
A mix of Avenir Next and system fonts with Georgia for inputs.

rules.name: The Organic Canvas Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds and surfaces avoid pure white and stark gray, leaning entirely on warm, paper-like creams and botanical greens.

dos: Do use uppercase, tracked-out text for kickers and small labels.
Do use the terracotta accent for primary actions and highlights.
donts: Don't use pure black (#000000) for text; always use Deep Forest Black.
Don't use sharp corners on cards or buttons (inputs are the exception).
